cumleler: Is a cholesteatoma a tumor, and does it involve cholesterol?
A cholesteatoma is keratin-producing skin in the middle ear or mastoid.
This skin constantly sheds dead cell debris into a sac.
The name misleads: not a tumor, and not directly about cholesterol.
But it grows over time and can erode the ossicles.
